source_refs.note: Roman Urdu introduction to electromagnetic radiation (PDF 186-187).

blocks.text: Roshni aur electromagnetic radiation ki doosri shakalein thartharate bijli aur magnetic fields se bani lehron ki shakal mein safar karti hain. Lehrein apni wavelength (lambda) aur frequency (nu) se bayan hoti hain, aur roshni ki raftaar, c = 3.0 x 10^8 m/s, se chalti hain. In ka taalluq c = lambda x nu hai, jahan lambda meters mein, nu hertz (s^-1) mein aur c m/s mein hai.

Electromagnetic spectrum mein radio waves, microwaves, infrared radiation, nazar aane wali roshni, ultraviolet radiation, X-rays aur gamma rays shamil hain. Planck ke quantum nazariye ke mutabiq atoms aur molecules sirf muqarrara miqdar (quanta) mein tawanai chhorte ya jazb karte hain, aur radiation ki tawanai us ki frequency ke barah-e-raast mutanasib hai: E = h nu = hc / lambda, jahan h Planck's constant, 6.626 x 10^-34 J s, hai. Spectroscopy mein wavenumber, 1/lambda, bhi use hota hai, aam taur par cm^-1 mein, jo tawanai ke mutanasib hai.

blocks.alt: Ufqi patti gamma rays, X-rays, ultraviolet, visible, infrared, microwave aur radio waves mein bati, teer daen taraf wavelength barhti dikhata, gamma sire par sab se zyada aur radio sire par sab se kam tawanai. Patla visible hissa 400 se 750 nm tak dhanak ki shakal mein phaila. Neeche: c = lambda x nu aur E = h nu = hc/lambda.
blocks.caption: Electromagnetic spectrum aur visible hissa (Figure 29.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Gamma rays se radio waves ki taraf wavelength lambi hoti, is liye har photon ki frequency aur tawanai kam hoti hai. Nazar aane wali roshni, 400-750 nm, sirf patli patti hai; UV-visible spectroscopy taqreeban 200-800 nm aur infrared spectroscopy lambi wavelengths use karti hai.

blocks.prompt: Fi photon kis ki tawanai zyada hai, ultraviolet ya infrared? Wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation: Ultraviolet: is ki wavelength chhoti aur frequency zyada hai, aur E = h nu = hc/lambda.

items: c = lambda x nu; E = h nu = hc/lambda.
Chhoti wavelength yani zyada frequency aur tawanai.
